efficiencyOverride.label: Efficiency fallback
efficiencyOverride.hintLearned: TeslaMate has already learned the efficiency — the learned value takes precedence, the fallback is inactive.
efficiencyOverride.hintNotLearned: Used for the consumption estimate until TeslaMate has learned the efficiency from your first charging sessions. Leave empty to remove. Existing drives are automatically recalculated (≤60 s).

sync.title: Sync
sync.errorHint: Error details as a tooltip on the status badge.
sync.resyncConfirmMessage: All sync watermarks will be reset and fully resynced on the worker's next tick. Continue?
sync.resyncSuccess: Watermarks reset — the worker will fetch everything again on its next tick (≤60 s).

display.title: Display
display.note: The time zone is set via the APP_TIMEZONE environment variable. Date/unit format is fixed to de-DE / km in the MVP.

about.title: About Odovi
about.supportDescription: Best-effort community support without a response-time SLA.
about.securityDescription: Report suspected vulnerabilities privately, not in a public issue.

tesla.title: Tesla Fleet API
tesla.description: Sends the checkpoints of a planned roadtrip directly to the vehicle navigation.
tesla.notConfigured: Tesla developer credentials and token encryption must be configured on the server.
tesla.pairHint: Before the first send, pair Odovi' virtual key with the vehicle once through the Tesla app.

providerReview.title: Location Provider Review
providerReview.description: The local archive remains available without these services. Review each optional capability independently before any named provider may receive location data.

notice.title: Location Provider Review required
notice.description: One or more optional location capabilities remain disabled until their current disclosure has been reviewed. Your archive continues to work.

activation.enabledHint: Location data is sent only when this feature needs it.
activation.disabledHint: Off — no location data is sent for this feature.
activation.publicHint: Uses the public provider and operating limits shown above.
activation.customHint: For a self-hosted or separately contracted endpoint.

weather.name: Weather
weather.purpose: Show current weather and add historical weather to archived drives.
weather.data: Exact or rounded journey coordinates and the requested time or date.
weather.experience: Enables weather cards and historical weather context for drives.
weather.limits: Open-Meteo public access is best-effort and should be treated as evaluation or permitted personal/non-commercial use unless you have suitable terms.

elevation.name: Elevation
elevation.purpose: Add elevation values to archived and planned route points.
elevation.experience: Enables elevation profiles, ascent and descent, and route energy estimates.
elevation.limits: Open-Meteo public access is best-effort and should be treated as evaluation or permitted personal/non-commercial use unless you have suitable terms.

mapTiles.name: Map tiles
mapTiles.purpose: Load a geographic background for interactive maps.
mapTiles.data: The visible map area as tile coordinates, plus normal browser request data.
mapTiles.experience: Enables interactive map backgrounds behind locally stored routes and places.
mapTiles.limits: OpenStreetMap public tiles allow ordinary interactive viewing with attribution and normal browser caching; no bulk download or offline prefetch.

addressSearch.name: Address search
addressSearch.purpose: Turn an entered place or address into coordinates.
addressSearch.data: The submitted search text, language, and normal server request data.
addressSearch.experience: Enables address suggestions when creating places or planning a trip.
addressSearch.limits: Public Nominatim permits low-volume, identified, user-triggered searches; it is rate-limited and has no availability guarantee.

routing.name: Routing
routing.purpose: Calculate a road route between selected waypoints.
routing.data: Exact start, destination, and intermediate waypoint coordinates.
routing.experience: Enables calculated road distance, duration, geometry, and route forecasts.
routing.limits: The public OSRM demo is for evaluation only, is rate-limited, has no SLA, and is not reliable production routing.

externalNavigation.name: External navigation
externalNavigation.purpose: Open a selected destination in an external navigation service.
externalNavigation.data: The destination coordinates selected for that explicit handoff.
externalNavigation.experience: Enables one-click handoff from a saved roadtrip to turn-by-turn navigation.
externalNavigation.limits: Google Maps is an independent external service. The destination is transferred only after an explicit click, and Google's terms and availability apply.

providerReview.credentialHint: If this header is set, its value must be supplied to web and worker through {variable}. The secret is never stored in Odovi.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics

operationalStatus.degraded: Odovi is ready with limited optional or synchronization functions

diagnostics.rowFailure: The last run failed. Recovery steps are shown below; technical details remain in the container logs.

teslamateTest.title: TeslaMate direct test
teslamateTest.description: Read-only test against TESLAMATE_DATABASE_URL from the web container (only counts drives, writes nothing).
teslamateTest.envNotSet: TESLAMATE_DATABASE_URL is not set in the web container — this test is for diagnostics only and not needed in normal operation, since only the worker reads the TeslaMate database.
teslamateTest.envNotSetMessage: TESLAMATE_DATABASE_URL is not set in the web container. That's fine in normal operation — only the worker needs it.
teslamateTest.successMessage: Connection successful — {count} drives found in the TeslaMate database.
teslamateTest.connectionFailed: TeslaMate is not reachable from the web container. Check the database container or host, network and TESLAMATE_DATABASE_URL.
teslamateTest.authenticationFailed: TeslaMate rejected the database login. Check the documented read-only user and password in TESLAMATE_DATABASE_URL.
teslamateTest.timeout: The TeslaMate connection timed out. Check the host, Docker network, firewall and database availability.

hints.dbUnreachable: The Odovi database is not reachable. Is the db container running? Is DATABASE_URL correctly set in the web container?
hints.neverSynced: Never synced yet. Is the worker container running? Is TESLAMATE_DATABASE_URL set in the worker?
hints.someNeverSynced: At least one area has never synced successfully. Check the worker logs: docker compose logs worker.
hints.stale: The last successful sync was a while ago. Is the worker container still running? Check the docker logs: docker compose logs worker.
hints.runFailed: At least one sync run failed — see the error message below the relevant row.
hints.migrationsIncomplete: Database migrations are incomplete. Run docker compose up migrate, wait for it to finish successfully, then restart web and worker.
hints.protectedUnavailable: The protected application schema is unavailable. Check docker compose logs migrate and restore the database from a verified backup if migration failed part-way.
hints.teslamateUnavailable: TeslaMate could not be checked. Confirm that its database is running and TESLAMATE_DATABASE_URL in the worker uses the documented read-only role, then restart the worker.
hints.teslamateIncompatible: The connected TeslaMate schema is outside the supported range. Check the installed TeslaMate version against the release notes before restarting the worker.
hints.optionalProviderUnavailable: An activated map, search, routing, weather or elevation provider is unavailable. The Core Archive remains usable. Check internet/DNS and the provider endpoint or disable that capability under Provider Review.

errors.newPasswordMinLength: New password must be at least 8 characters.
